# Infiltrator
Infiltrators are a critical member of the team with a kit meant to facilitate easy breaking-and-entering, perfect for reaching difficult-to-get items or machines that need to be sabotaged.
## Tools of the Trade Their cache contains an EMAG, two C-4 charges, a pinpointer, and a chameleon projector for sneaking around unseen.
### EMAG Can be used to open any airlock or locker, damaging them in the process and bolting open airlocks. It only has a few uses, so make sure to make them count!
### Chameleon Projector When used, hides your body as a small piece of trash. When cloaked, you'll be significantly slower and unable to use tools or weapons. Make sure to stay out of peoples' way, since being hit or grabbed will make you visible again!
### Pinpointer When active, points towards the location of the nuke disk. While security override terminals also display the location of the disk, the pinpointer allow you to track down the holder without needing to break into a secure area.
### C4 Blows up whatever is on the tile it's on, and not much else. Great for breaching, but not that good at damaging players. Must be planted to arm; cannot be manually activated like other explosives.
